heading_path: Buyer's Guide Contact the Price Advisory Group
blocks.markdown: Contact the Price Advisory Group You may engage with subject matter experts, including price advisors for procurements with a total estimated value of $7,500,000 or more. You may also consult price advisors on any matter where financial advice is deemed helpful. The Price Advisory Group provides the following services and more: advice on matters related to pricing considerations and validation mitigation of pricing risks associated with complex or negotiated procurements contract cost-price analysis negotiations of costing rates development of basis of payment strategies to achieve best value Contact the Price Advisory Group
